# Pull Request Template

## Description

Please describe the changes you've made and the motivation behind them.

## What's Changed

- List the main changes you've made

## Checklist

- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] I have performed a self-review of my code
- [ ] I have updated the README.md if needed
- [ ] I have added/updated TypeScript types if needed
- [ ] I have tested the changes locally
- [ ] Related issue has been closed (Closes #issue-number)

## Type of Change

- [ ] New feature
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] Performance improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Refactoring
- [ ] Dependency update

## Screenshots/GIFs

If applicable, add screenshots or GIFs demonstrating the UI changes.

## Related Issues

Closes #issue-number

## Additional Context

Any additional context about the PR.
